name: Look To The Stars
summary: Viktori Prism'Antras needs a mirror for the telescope he is building in Darkshire from Cog's blueprints. He sends you south to find Mary, known for carrying a looking glass.

sections.title: A Reflective Surface
sections.body: Viktori Prism'Antras has the bronze tube for his telescope. Cog's blueprints call for a mirror to guide and reflect light through it. Fine silvered glass is hard to make while Darkshire faces shortages. So Viktori recalls Mary, a local woman known across the region for carrying a looking glass.

sections.title: Searching the South
sections.body: Mary's old home lies deep in southern Duskwood, just north of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. To reach it, you pass beyond the Night Watch's safe patrols. Blighted groves lie ahead, where ravenous wolves, feral spiders, and wandering undead roam.

sections.title: A Tragic Resident
sections.body: Blind Mary is a wandering spirit near her old home and the cemetery. Her shack in the south reveals what became of the woman Viktori remembered. Bound to memories and possessions from her former life, she remains near the place she once called home.

faq.answer: Viktori is building an astronomical telescope in his hut up the hill in Darkshire. He follows designs made by Cog, a tinker.

faq.q: Why does Viktori need a looking glass?
faq.answer: Cog's blueprints call for a mirror to reflect and focus light through the telescope. Viktori remembers Mary carried a looking glass and hopes to use it in the assembly.
Mary's ruined home is in southeastern Duskwood, just north of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

Mary lived in southern Duskwood before the land fell into cursed darkness. People around Darkshire knew her for carrying a looking glass. At her old home near Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, you can learn what became of her.

faq.q: Does Mary still have her looking glass?
faq.answer: Mary says she once owned a looking glass, but no longer has it. She can only point you toward where it went.
Undead, feral duskbats, venom web spiders, and rabid wolves prowl the southeastern woods and Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. They prey on travelers who venture south of Darkshire.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, helping Viktori build his telescope brings a rare glimmer of curiosity and progress to a town consumed by terror and rot.
As an engineer, you follow precise optical plans for telescope assembly. Gnomish blueprints guide the work of reflecting and magnifying faint starlight.
